programmes.d: Embark on a road trip across Europe to uncover the soul of this 912-bhp Audi.
Test the Ford GT, Porsche 911 GT2 RS, AMG GT R and Lotus Exige Cup 430 at the Anglesey Coastal Circuit.
Is this generation of the Porsche 911 GT3 RS the ultimate track and road car? Then, test the McLaren 765LT.
Join Adam Towler in adrenaline-pumping trips inside Subaru rally cars.
Put the last combustion-powered Lotus through its paces. Then, find out if the Ferrari 296 GTB thrills.
Witness a supercar that Gordon Murray's had in his head for 25 years. Then, take a Cayman GT4 RS for a spin.
How does this fabulous M3 fare with power to all four wheels? Then, can this Lamborghini beat the McLaren P1?
Does this Toyota hot hatch live up to the hype? Then, take to the ice with a Yaris.
Ian Roussel redesigns a 1931 Ford jalopy into a 1950s-style hot rod for a client.
Car builder Ian Roussel finds an old 1960's dune buggy and tries to give it a modern twist for a client.
Car builder Ian Roussel tackles a 1955 Oldsmobile that has seen better days.
Car builder Ian Roussel transforms a historic but beat-up '55 Oldsmobile.
Car maker Ian Roussel makes the ultimate shop van out of an old 1949 international milk truck.
Ian Roussel attempts to transform a 1962 Thunderbird into a unique custom vehicle complete with a bubble top.
Ian Roussel continues to transform a 1962 T-bird bubble top.
Danny finds a rare 1960 delivery vehicle to show off at the Viva Vegas car show, and after Mike gets in trouble at work, the guys decide to build Danny a customized coffin couch.

Kevin is won over by a hotrod pick-up truck, Danny tracks down a customer's original 1969 Firebird but its terrible condition may make it impossible to restore, and an unannounced visitor causes drama at the shop.

Emotions run deep when Danny receives an astronomical offer for one of his prized cars. Kevin helps spot an epic flip that brings in a ton of cash and the guys visit SEMA, the world's biggest and most extravagant auto show.

Chumlee from Gold & Silver stops by to pick up his custom 1963 Lincoln, but gets some really bad news instead. Later a casino VIP commissions a bike inspired by the largest chunk of gold in the world.
The shop agrees to build a brave father a hot rod wheelchair, and Danny gets stuck in a bind when a pink car project doesn't go as planned.

Kevin's brother is a judge, but that won't get him a free ride, and the guys struggle to finish his '62 Chevy pick-up within budget. Later, Scott spots an incredibly rare Corvette, but will he screw up the deal without Danny's help?
The shop has its hands full with a custom psychedelic bike, and Danny's infamous friend.
Danny has a last-minute change of heart and can't let go of a classic car he promised to sell to a loyal customer.

Danny builds an extra special car for a customer who wants something no one else has--a tribute car of the rare Yenko Nova. Later, he visits one of the world's most exclusive car collections to find a car for a client with very expensive taste.
Ziggy Marley meets Danny at Vamp'd to commission a restoration on his father, Bob Marley's, vintage Mercedes.

It's all hands on deck as the shop rushes to finish restoring the last car Bob Marley ever owned. They must hustle to deliver it to Ziggy Marley in LA while Horny Mike takes on a dangerous side project with teeth.

Danny tries to score an ex-police motorcycle without getting busted, while a water main break threatens to put the shop permanently underwater. Will Danny be able to get the shop back up and running, or will it be a complete washout?
The underdog Golf R takes on the mighty Audi RS3. Then, test the M3's drift analyser.
How does the G80 BMW M3 stack up against a trio of performance car heroes? Then, enjoy a Mini Cooper.
Harry Metcalfe shows off one of his favorites. Then, experience a Lamborghini Gallardo.
Test a modern reimagining of Subaru's iconic Impreza STI 22B. Then, get to know the cars of the evo team.
Find out if the 600LT is quicker than Porsche 911 GT3. Then, 2017's evo Car of the Year sets a lap time.
Dickie Meaden and Steve Sutcliffe race each other in i30 Ns. Then, explore the fascinating Col de Turini.
An Alfa Romeo battles the thunderous Mercedes AMG C 63. And Henry Catchpole reviews the Boxster Spyder.
Ride across Europe in the spacious Ferrari FF. Then, have a ton of fun in the Ariel Nomad.
Dive into the devilish details of the McLaren F1. Then, witness the Audi S1 launch near the Arctic Circle.
The evo team tests 16 stunning cars to decide which contenders will make it to the finale. Part 1 of 2.
With eight cars remaining, the evo team explores the Scottish Borders for the final reckoning. Part 2 of 2.
Steve drives four different courses to reveal how to get the most out of the BMW performance car.
Take the ultimate pilgrimage for the performance car enthusiast. Then, the i30 N excels in northern Scotland.
The McLaren is in for the fight of its life on the track against a 911 GT3. Then, a battle of Porsches.
Harry Metcalfe guides us through the history of the Lamborghini V12.
Get a taste of the revolutionary 155-mph i8 hybrid car. Then, an unfair track battle.
Jethro Bovingdon compares the F12 to the 599 GTO. Then, the M4 gets a true test.
Henry Catchpole introduces us to McLaren's first Sports Series supercar. Then, an R8 GT Spyder at Silverstone.
Explore a new kind of electrified Mustang. Then, similar cars compete in the fun column.
Join Harry Metcalfe on the amazing three-day Lamborghini 50th anniversary tour.
Get a look at some stunning cars at the Quail show at the Pebble Beach weekend. Then, April fools.
